w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE FOCUS GROUP! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Spool. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: They didn't come to your fire. Hardliners don't ask — Nora is building something out there, and it isn't a farm.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/12/6), with 6 wave-4 fought, 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 16 · Craft 9 · Talk 16 · Explore 39 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Vasyl Shevchenko ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Kennedy Ramirez and Vasyl Shevchenko ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
